BUSANO Punong Barangay Barangay Biabas Municipality of Guindulman Province of Bohol Dear PB Busano: This has reference to your letter dated February 28, 2024 seeking for this Department's opinion on the validity of collection of fees and/or charges by Eskaya Tribal Group in Brgy. Biabas, Guindulman, Bohol. To answer your question, allow us first to restate the pertinent provision of the Local Government Code of 1991 and we quote: Section 130. The following fundamental principles shall govern the exercise of the taxing and other revenue-raising powers of local government units. (a) Xxx (b) Xxx (c) The Collection of local taxes, fees, charges and other impositions shall in no case be let to any private person; (d) Xxx (e) Xxx The general principles on taxation also apply to the taxing power of LGUs. Local government taxes shall be uniform, equitable and devoted to public purposes and not unjust, excessive, confiscatory, oppressive, contrary to law and public policy, national economic policy or in restraint of trade. The collection of local taxes. fees. charges and other impositions cannot be contracted to private parties. Under Republic Act (RA) No. 8731 or otherwise known as "The Indigenous People's Rights Act of 1997" Chapter II (n), People's Organization is referred to a private, non- profit voluntary of members of an Indigenous Cultural Communities (ICC for brevity) or Indigenous People (IP for brevity) which is accepted as representative of such ICCs/lPs. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

The Eskaya Tribal Group is a part of ICC and from the definition provided above the Eskaya Tribal Group is considered a private person in which they cannot be contracted to collect local taxes, fees, charges and other impositions. Taxes, Charges and Fees are pecuniary charges imposed by legislature or other public authority upon persons or property for public purposes and it is a forced contribution of wealth to meet the public needs of government. This opinion is being rendered based on the facts you have presented and without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities or the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, By th Authority of the Secretary: AT UAN TOR R. LLAMAS ersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs USELLA/JVRULLLS-LRALLD/agbl LEOCADIO T.
